name: Naan
description: Leavened white-flour bread slapped onto the wall of a tandoor.

tcm.note: Leavened and fiercely dry-baked — warmer than a plain flatbread.

ayurveda.note: Fermented dough turns wheat's shita, the same logic that makes leavened bread heating.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; maida plus yeast plus tandoor heat.

histamine.note: Yeast-leavened and often enriched with yogurt — both push it above an unleavened roti.

nutrition.highlight: leavened, then blistered in a tandoor

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
